tail.title: Add CSV export to the reports page, with tests and a docs section.
tail.text: Add CSV export to the reports page, with tests and a docs section.
On it. I will split this into the API, the UI and the docs, one piece each.

tail.title: API: GET /reports.csv
tail.text: Expose GET /reports.csv returning RFC 4180 CSV of the visible rows. Only touch src/routes/reports.ts and its test.
bar: returns text/csv with a header row

tail.title: UI: Export button
tail.text: Add an Export button to /reports that downloads from GET /reports.csv. Only touch src/pages/Reports.tsx.
bar: button sits next to the filters

tail.title: Docs: Export to CSV
tail.text: Write an "Export to CSV" section in README.md that says what the file holds.
Bruno builds the button against your route. Agree the column names with him directly, not through me.
The route returns id, title, owner and created_at, in that order. Does the button need anything else?

tail.title: Download file name
tail.text: Which file name should the download use? I will send it in Content-Disposition.
The Export button is next to the filters and downloads the file.
Those columns work for the button. Nothing else needed.
Use reports-YYYY-MM-DD.csv. The button reads it from Content-Disposition, so nothing is hard coded on my side.
GET /reports.csv returns RFC 4180 CSV named reports-YYYY-MM-DD.csv. The quoting test covers commas, quotes and line breaks.
Added the "Export to CSV" section to README.md: columns, file name, and the row limit.
CSV export shipped: the API with its quoting test (Ana), the Export button (Bruno) and the README section (Cleo). All three pieces passed my check.

tail.title: Next: add a PDF export of the same report.
tail.text: Next: add a PDF export of the same report.
Starting on PDF. Ana takes the renderer and will split it with subagents.

tail.title: PDF: render the report
tail.text: Render the visible report rows to PDF at GET /reports.pdf. Split the work with subagents if it helps.
Got the PDF piece. I am running two subagents: one reads the report templates, one writes the snapshot test.
